activity.description: the activity, product or service the aspect arises from, e.g. bulk earthworks

aspect.description: the element that interacts with the environment, e.g. dust generation

compliance_obligation.description: the legal or other requirement that applies to the aspect

control_or_influence.description: whether the organisation controls the aspect or can only influence it

external_id.description: the source's own register row id

impact.description: the environmental change the aspect causes or can cause

life_cycle_stage.description: the life-cycle stage the aspect belongs to

project.description: the project the aspect is assessed for, when the register is per project

significance_criteria.description: the criteria significance was judged against

significant.description: whether the aspect is a significant environmental aspect

source_system.description: which bound system emitted the row
